t: 东罗马皇太后维丽娜在君士坦丁堡煽动骚乱，并劝说女婿芝诺皇帝逃离。然而，拜占庭元老院拥戴巴西利斯…
te: Verina, the Eastern Roman dowager Empress, instigates a riot in Constantinople and persuades emperor Zeno, her son-in-l…
dz: 东罗马皇太后维丽娜在君士坦丁堡煽动骚乱，并劝说女婿芝诺皇帝逃离。然而，拜占庭元老院拥戴巴西利斯库斯为皇帝，而不是她的情人帕特里修斯。
de: Verina, the Eastern Roman dowager Empress, instigates a riot in Constantinople and persuades emperor Zeno, her son-in-law, to flee. The Byzantine senate, however, acclaims Basiliscus as emperor and not her lover Patricius.

t: 拜占庭皇帝泽诺被迫出逃于君士坦丁堡的首都,他的将领巴西利斯克获得了帝国的控制权.
te: Byzantine Emperor Zeno is forced to flee his capital at Constantinople, and his general, Basiliscus gains control of th…
dz: 拜占庭皇帝泽诺被迫出逃于君士坦丁堡的首都,他的将领巴西利斯克获得了帝国的控制权.
de: Byzantine Emperor Zeno is forced to flee his capital at Constantinople, and his general, Basiliscus gains control of the empire.

t: 拜占庭皇帝巴西利斯库斯向其帝国的主教们发了一封通函(Enkyklikon),支持单体基督教立场.
te: Byzantine Emperor Basiliscus issues a circular letter (Enkyklikon) to the bishops of his empire, supporting the Monophy…
dz: 拜占庭皇帝巴西利斯库斯向其帝国的主教们发了一封通函(Enkyklikon),支持单体基督教立场.
de: Byzantine Emperor Basiliscus issues a circular letter (Enkyklikon) to the bishops of his empire, supporting the Monophysite christological position.

t: 罗马将军奥瑞斯忒斯迫使西罗马皇帝朱利叶斯·尼波斯逃离他的首都拉文纳。
te: The Roman general Orestes forces western Roman Emperor Julius Nepos to flee his capital city, Ravenna.
dz: 罗马将军奥瑞斯忒斯迫使西罗马皇帝朱利叶斯·尼波斯逃离他的首都拉文纳。
de: The Roman general Orestes forces western Roman Emperor Julius Nepos to flee his capital city, Ravenna.

t: 罗穆卢斯·奥古斯都卢斯被宣布为西罗马皇帝.
te: Romulus Augustulus is proclaimed Western Roman Emperor.
dz: 罗穆卢斯·奥古斯都卢斯被宣布为西罗马皇帝.
de: Romulus Augustulus is proclaimed Western Roman Emperor.
